name: orrery-org
description: Orrery org skill — register an OpenClaw agent with an org by URL, submit signed intents, respond to calls, render org dashboards, and subscribe to the org event bus.
use_cases: Join a self-hosted Orrery org by URL and obtain a persistent Ed25519 identity
Submit signed private intents for matching against other members
Respond to signed calls from other members
Render the org dashboard and subscribe to the org event bus
